# Survival Hunter — Raid (group)

[Hunter](../README.md) > [Raid (group)](README.md) > Survival

**[Survival — melee with a Raptor](../research/raid/builds/survival-raptor-raid.md)** (16/4/31) — [open the talent tree](https://talentsforever.com/hunter/60/53200005001-004-500230230050022151-12)

## How to play

**Before the pull:** **Hunter's Mark**, **Aspect of the Beast**.

**Keep up all fight:** **Aspect of the Beast**.

**Then press the first one that is ready**, top to bottom:

1. **Raptor Strike**; no global cooldown, so press it alongside the others
2. **Hunter's Mark**: keep it on the target
3. **Mongoose Bite** when it lights up (Expose Prey on your marked target; a dodge of yours too)
4. **Strider Kick**
5. **Immolation Trap**
6. **Summon Hawk**
7. **Wing Clip**

**Out of melee:** step out to re-apply **Serpent Sting** when it falls off while **Strider Kick**'s speed is up, and shoot **Arcane Shot** and **Multi-Shot** on the way back in; never step out only to shoot.

**Wing Clip** is your filler: cast it whenever nothing above is ready.

**Advanced: your cooldowns and extras.** Once the list above feels easy, add these:

- **Rapid Fire**: a cooldown, use it at the start of the fight and again whenever it is ready (about 1 time a fight)
- Use your trinkets and a potion together with your big cooldowns.

*The simulator's full rotation for this build, with every condition: [research rotation page](../research/raid/rotation.md).*

## Why this rotation

Raid Survival fights in melee with two one-handers and a Raptor out: **Raptor Strike** whenever it is ready, **Hunter's Mark** kept up for **Expose Prey**, **Mongoose Bite** each time it lights up, **Strider Kick**, **Immolation Trap** and **Summon Hawk** on cooldown and **Wing Clip** in every global cooldown left, stepping out for **Serpent Sting** when it falls off. This is the official simulator's own melee rotation, build and pet (since the evening of 2026-11-20, when it beat ours by 4.1% on this build). In a 3-minute raid fight: **Wing Clip** 35 casts, **Raptor Strike** 24, **Summon Hawk** 22, **Mongoose Bite** 20, **Strider Kick** 20, **Immolation Trap** 10, **Serpent Sting** 9; the Raptor's and the hawks' swings 23% of the damage (one line in the record), your white swings 23%, **Immolation Trap** 7%, **Serpent Sting** 7%, Windfury Totem's extra swings 7%, **Raptor Strike** 7%, **Mongoose Bite** 6%, **Strider Kick** 5%.

**Why it works**

- Before the pull: **Hunter's Mark** and **Aspect of the Beast** (+110 melee attack power; with **Deadly Aspects** each melee auto attack has a 10% chance to speed your swings by 30% for 12 seconds). The simulator starts you 25 yards out and walks you in, casting **Serpent Sting**, **Arcane Shot** and **Multi-Shot** on the way. From 5 seconds in the other cooldowns go as they come ready: **Rapid Fire** (in Forever 40% faster melee attacks too, for 15 seconds) once, your on-use trinket (the page's sets carry Blackhand's Breadth) and a Major Mana Potion.
- **Raptor Strike** first: it replaces your next main-hand swing and costs no global cooldown, so queue it whenever its 6-second cooldown ends.
- **Hunter's Mark** whenever it is missing: with **Expose Prey**, each of your hits on a marked target has a 10% chance to light up **Mongoose Bite** for 10 seconds, and in a raid the boss hits your tank, so your own dodges, the bite's other trigger, rarely come. Bite at once (weapon damage plus 57, 5-second cooldown); **Lacerating Strikes** adds a bleed of 40% of it over 21 seconds (1.3% of your damage), which the next bite replaces, as in game.
- **Strider Kick** on cooldown (full weapon damage, 8 seconds), and its 3 seconds of 30% speed are your window for **Serpent Sting**: with the sting off the boss and more than 30% mana, run out past your shots' 8-yard minimum range (the simulator goes to about 13 yards), sting, shoot **Arcane Shot** and **Multi-Shot** if they are ready, and walk back in, pausing for an **Auto Shot** when one is due.
- **Immolation Trap** whenever it is ready, set in melee at the boss: 690 Fire damage over 15 seconds, 30% more with **Clever Traps**, every 18 seconds with **Survivalist's Discipline**.
- **Summon Hawk** next: a dive, then a hawk that attacks for 18 seconds, two at a time, 15% harder with **Unleashed Fury**. It shares its cooldown with **Arcane Shot**, which the list casts only from range.
- **Wing Clip** fills every global cooldown left: its own hit is 50 damage, but each hit on your marked target is another 10% chance at **Mongoose Bite**.
- The Raptor is the simulator's own choice (Faster Attack II, a 1.6-second swing); its Claw is 4% of your damage, and **Focused Fire** adds 2% to you both while it is out.

**Caveats**

- Full raid: every raid buff and debuff, phase-1 gear, 3-minute fights. Windfury Totem's extra swings are 7% of your damage: you need a shaman's totem in your group.
- Mana: no **Resourcefulness** or **Efficiency** in this build. On the simulator's training dummy (your own buffs only), the raid's mana buffs alone (Mana Spring Totem, Mana Tide Totem, Greater Blessing of Wisdom, Judgement of Wisdom) add 31% to its damage, and in a full raid it still drinks a Major Mana Potion a fight.
- The class page says **Expose Prey** needs your own **Hunter's Mark**; the simulator accepts any hunter's. With several hunters, make sure the mark on the boss is yours.
- Traps in combat are the simulator's assumption, still to check in game: a trap lies where you stand and springs on the boss beside you, so the list sets it only in melee.
- Keep the Raptor alive with **Mend Pet**: Forever pets take no stat buffs from players. The hawks' attacks after the dive are the simulator's fit to combat logs.
- Ranks: **Serpent Sting** rank 8 (rank 9 is a class book, not in Forever on the evidence there is, 2026-11-20) and **Aspect of the Beast** rank 4.

**When to change it**

- Adds around you: **Multi-Shot** on the way in hits 3 targets, and for a pack set **Explosive Trap** instead of **Immolation Trap** (everything within 10 yards). The official list never casts it, and the simulator gives all traps one cooldown, so it is one or the other.
- When you must leave the boss, make **Strider Kick** your last hit: 30% movement speed for 3 seconds.
- If you pull threat, **Feign Death** (30-second cooldown).
- Short on mana: the list already skips the **Serpent Sting** trips below 30%; let **Wing Clip** go next, about 70 damage for 80 mana in this build's full-raid numbers, the least for its mana of anything you press.
